messages:
Amy Chen: morning team :wave: we need a quick sync — Snowflake + Databricks connector bundle + AuroraHW edge node listing on GCP marketplace. goal: coordinated cert, single marketplace listing, joint announcement in 3 weeks. who owns test matrix?
Raj Patel: I can take cert test matrix. need clarity on supported model sizes and quantization variants for AuroraHW. also: perf SLOs for Dedicated vs Private.
Lisa Morales: I'll own the packaging + listing copy. need final logos, one-liner, and contact for co-marketing. can somebody confirm legal/partner naming?
Miguel Torres: ops note: AuroraHW requires signed images and a firmware checklist. we need a validation harness — can we reuse the qdrant connector runner?
Raj Patel: yes miguel, that's doable. I'll add tests: correctness, kvcache persistence, quantized int8 path. quick snippet for the runner: 
```
./run_integration_tests --connector snowflake --vector qdrant --hw aurorahw --profile ci-small
```
Amy Chen: @Lisa I'll DM you the logos and partner contact. Marketing wants a soft announcement (blog + joint webinar) aligned with marketplace listing. can legal approve co-branded assets in 5 days?
Lisa Morales: that timeline is tight but workable if legal gets assets by EOD tomorrow. also need a short demo script (2-3 min) showing end-to-end: ingest -> embedding -> search.
Miguel Torres: hardware team can snapshot an Aurora image and publish to staging marketplace by Friday. need CI creds from marketplace bot. @MarketplaceBot can you create a staging listing token?
MarketplaceBot: Created staging token: stg-aurorahw-17185 (expires in 7 days). Link: https://console.marketplace.example/staging/aurorahw
Raj Patel: putting together acceptance criteria: unit tests, e2e ingest <= 800ms median, throughput >= 150 qps on bundle config, cert logs uploaded to S3 path: s3://redwood-cert/aurorahw/snow-dbx/17185
Amy Chen: ok owners: Raj = cert/tests, Lisa = listing + assets, Miguel = staging images + infra. next sync in 48 hrs. if blockers pop up, drop sig issues in this thread. :thumbsup:
Lisa Morales: noted. i'll open a shared doc and invite partner PMs. will ping legal.
Miguel Torres: will schedule hw snapshot and ping eng-infra for kernel compat checks.
Raj Patel: I'll start the perf runs tonight and post results here.
Amy Chen: thanks everyone — let's keep the announcement date flexible until cert green. will update roadmap once tests land.
